title: Measuring Market Power in Network-Constrained Markets
Market Performance Assessment in Locational Markets with Non-Convexities and Storage
Nuclear Operations with a High Penetration of Renewables: The Case of France
abstract: Nuclear and intermittent renewables (wind and solar) are generally regarded as the only scalable technologies producing low-carbon electricity. However, the extent to which these technologies can co-exist in a reliable power system depends on whether nuclear units can adjust their operations to renewable output fluctuations. Using hourly data from the French power system, we find that nuclear units are operated quite flexibly, and that the foregone energy production due to "load following" actions (relative to the counterfactual of operating at full capacity during load following events) is currently limited. However, we find that an additional load following event is associated with a slightly higher likelihood of a unit failure. We also find that unit-level minimum output constraints are binding more frequently as system-wide renewable generation increases, especially so for units most exposed to solar generation. In 2024, hours during which available nuclear flexibility was exhausted are associated with non-positive hourly day-ahead prices.
abstract_zh: 核能与间歇性可再生能源（风能和太阳能）通常被视为仅有的、能够大规模生产低碳电力的技术。然而，这些技术能否在可靠的电力系统中共存，取决于核电机组能否调整运行以应对可再生能源出力的波动。利用法国电力系统的小时级数据，我们发现核电机组的运行相当灵活，而且由“负荷跟随”操作（相对于在负荷跟随事件期间满负荷运行的反事实情形）造成的能量损失目前处于有限水平。然而，我们发现，每增加一次负荷跟随事件，机组故障的可能性会略微上升。我们还发现，随着全系统可再生能源发电量的增加，机组层面的最低出力约束越来越频繁地起约束作用，对于最易受太阳能发电影响的机组尤为如此。2024年，核电可用灵活性耗尽的时段与小时级日前电价非正值相关联。

title: Under the Hood: Penalty Parameters for System Constraint Violations in Short-Term Wholesale Electricity Market-Clearing Mechanisms
Electric Vehicles and the Energy Transition: Unintended Consequences of Time-of-Use Pricing
abstract: The growth of electric vehicles (EVs) raises new challenges for electricity systems. We implement a field experiment to assess the effect of time-of-use (TOU) pricing and managed charging on EV charging behavior. We find that while TOU pricing is effective at shifting EV charging into off-peak hours, it unintentionally induces new and larger “shadow peaks” of simultaneous charging. These shadow peaks lead to greater exceedance of local capacity constraints and advance the need for distribution network upgrades. In contrast, centrally managed charging solves the coordination problem, reducing transformer capacity requirements, and is well tolerated by consumers in our setting. (JEL C93, D91, L62, L94, Q42)
abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）的增长给电力系统带来了新的挑战。我们开展了一项现场实验，以评估分时电价（TOU）定价和集中管理充电对电动汽车充电行为的影响。我们发现，尽管分时电价能有效地将电动汽车充电转移至非高峰时段，但它无意中催生了新的、规模更大的“影子高峰”，即大量车辆同时充电。这些影子高峰导致对本地容量约束的更大程度超限，并提前了配电网升级的需求。相比之下，集中管理的充电能够解决协调问题，降低变压器容量需求，并且在我们的研究环境中为消费者所乐于接受。（JEL C93, D91, L62, L94, Q42）

title: Show Me the Money! A Field Experiment on Electric Vehicle Charge Timing
abstract: We use a field experiment to measure the effectiveness of financial incentives to shift the timing of electric vehicle (EV) charging. EV owners respond strongly to financial incentives, reducing charging during peak hours by 49 percent by shifting to off-peak hours. In contrast, a prosocial information treatment has no discernible effect. When financial incentives are removed, charge timing reverts to pre-intervention behavior, reinforcing that “money matters.” Our findings highlight the substantial flexibility of EV charging compared to other forms of electricity demand. Such flexibility has the potential to greatly reduce future electric system costs arising from a rapidly decarbonizing transportation sector. (JEL C93, D12, D91, L92, L94, Q48)
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项现场实验，衡量经济激励措施在改变电动汽车（EV）充电时间方面的有效性。电动汽车车主对经济激励反应强烈，通过将充电转移至非高峰时段，高峰时段的充电量减少了49%。相比之下，具有亲社会性的信息干预并未产生可察觉的效果。当经济激励取消后，充电时间又恢复到干预前的行为，这进一步印证了“钱很重要”。我们的研究结果突显了电动汽车充电相较于其他形式电力需求所具有的巨大灵活性。在交通领域快速脱碳的背景下，这种灵活性有望大幅降低未来的电力系统成本。（JEL C93, D12, D91, L92, L94, Q48）

title: An Equivalence Test Approach to Rounding Parameter Estimates
Pricing transmission network and generation unit operating constraints in the European wholesale electricity market
Take the Load Off: Time and Technology as Determinants of Electricity Demand Response
abstract: As electricity systems transition toward more variable renewable energy, flexible demand has emerged as a critical tool for grid management. Yet a fundamental question remains: are emerging smart technologies sufficient to unlock demand response, or does human behavior remain the critical barrier? Our field experiment examines this question through a novel approach that individually randomizes peak event timing for each participating household, allowing us to leverage both within-subject and between-subject variation. We compare the response to “peak events” on electricity consumption for households equipped with three distinct demand response programs: a fully automated system requiring no action; app-enabled smart devices requiring minimal effort; and traditional manual adjustments. The results are striking—households with passive, automated responses reduced consumption five times more than those required to take any action at all, even when the burden is greatly reduced via smart technology. The provision of enabling technologies alone made no difference in households’ responsiveness, as compared to a fully manual setting, when active participation was still required. These findings reveal that the opportunity cost of time and effort—not technology limitations—may be the fundamental obstacle to unlocking electricity demand flexibility. To achieve its full potential, “smart home” technologies need to incorporate these behavioral realities as barriers to responsiveness. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 随着电力系统向更多可变可再生能源转型，灵活需求已成为电网管理的关键工具。然而，一个根本问题依然存在：新兴的智能技术是否足以释放需求响应潜力，还是人类行为仍是关键障碍？我们的现场实验通过一种新颖的方法考察这一问题：为每个参与家庭单独随机化高峰事件的时间，从而使我们能够同时利用受试者内部与受试者之间的变异。我们比较了三类不同需求响应项目下家庭对“高峰事件”的用电响应：完全自动化、无需任何操作的系统；需要极少努力的支持应用程序的智能设备；以及传统的手动调整。结果令人震惊：即使借助智能技术大幅降低了负担，那些采用被动自动化响应的家庭，其用电量减少幅度也是那些需要采取任何行动的家庭的五倍。在仍需主动参与的情况下，与完全手动的设置相比，仅仅提供使能技术对家庭的响应程度毫无影响。这些发现表明，时间与精力的机会成本（而非技术限制）可能是释放电力需求灵活性的根本障碍。要充分发挥“智能家居”技术的潜力，就需要将这些行为现实纳入其中，视其为影响响应的障碍。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Search with learning in the retail gasoline market
abstract: This article estimates a model of optimal search where consumers learn the distribution of gasoline prices during their driving trips. Our model incorporates traffic information and leverages this ordered search environment to recover parameters of the search and learning process using only station‐level price and market share data. We find that learning is a crucial component of search in this market. Consumers' prior beliefs regularly deviate from the true price distribution but are updated quickly following each new price observation. Counterfactuals reveal how these learning dynamics generate asymmetric search patterns commonly associated with asymmetric cost pass‐through.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了一个最优搜寻模型，其中消费者在驾车出行的过程中学习汽油价格的分布。我们的模型纳入了交通信息，并利用这一有序搜寻环境，仅使用加油站层面的价格和市场份额数据来恢复搜寻与学习过程的参数。我们发现，学习是该市场中搜寻行为的关键组成部分。消费者的先验信念经常偏离真实的价格分布，但在每次观察到新的价格后都会迅速更新。反事实分析揭示了这些学习动态如何产生与成本不对称传导相关的不对称搜寻模式。

title: Hydrogen Production Economics: A Compound Real Options and Policy Analysis
Market Design for the 21st Century: Recommendations for Alberta's Power Market
Reliability Options in Renewables-Dominated Electricity Markets
abstract: Recent energy shortfalls in renewables-dominated electricity markets call for a mechanism to ensure demand is met under all system conditions. We demonstrate severe shortcomings of an increasingly popular mechanism-reliability options-caused by its interaction with fixed-price forward contracts for energy. Large generators can trigger the option exercise, weakening the short-term incentive to sell output provided by forward contracts alone. In the longer term, hydro generators sell more forward contracts and store less water, reducing system reliability. We empirically show that Colombian generators respond to these incentives. We analyze a standardized energy contracting approach to long-term resource adequacy that does not create these economic incentives.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源主导的电力市场近期出现的能源短缺，要求建立一种机制以确保在所有系统条件下需求均能得到满足。我们证明，一种日益流行的机制（可靠性期权，reliability options）因其与能源固定价格远期合约之间的相互作用而存在严重缺陷。大型发电商可以触发期权行权，从而削弱了仅由远期合约所提供的、促使其在短期内出售产出的激励。从长期来看，水力发电商会签订更多远期合约并减少蓄水，从而降低系统可靠性。我们以哥伦比亚的发电商为例，实证表明它们确实对这些激励做出了反应。我们分析了一种标准化的能源合约方法，用于实现长期资源充裕性，该方法不会产生这些经济激励。

title: Can Distributed Intermittent Renewable Generation Reduce Future Grid Investments? Evidence from France
venue: Journal of the European Economic Association, 21(1), 367-412
abstract: This paper estimates the relationship between investments in five distributed generation technologies and hourly net withdrawals from over 2,000 electricity distribution networks in France between 2005 and 2018. We find that investments in distributed wind and solar generation have little or no impact on the annual peak of hourly net withdrawals from the distribution grid, while investments in hydroelectric and thermal distributed generation significantly reduce it. An optimistic analysis of the impact of investments in battery storage suggests that high levels are required for distributed wind and solar to deliver similar reductions in the annual peak of hourly net withdrawals. Our results imply that public policies favoring distributed wind and solar generation over utility-scale generation cannot be rationalized by savings in future grid investments.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了2005年至2018年间法国五类分布式发电技术的投资与超过2000个配电网的小时级净提取量之间的关系。我们发现，分布式风能和太阳能发电的投资对配电网小时级净提取量年度峰值几乎没有影响或毫无影响，而水电和热力分布式发电的投资则显著降低了该峰值。对储能电池投资影响的乐观分析表明，需要达到较高水平，分布式风能和太阳能才能实现类似的年度峰值降幅。我们的结果表明，优先发展分布式风能和太阳能而非大规模公用事业发电的公共政策，无法通过节省未来电网投资来加以合理化。

title: Can Forward Commodity Markets Improve Spot Market Performance? Evidence from Wholesale Electricity
abstract: Forward markets are believed to aggregate information about future spot prices and reduce the cost of producing the commodity. We develop a measure of the extent to which forward and spot prices agree in markets with transaction costs. Using this measure, we show that day-ahead prices better reflect real-time prices at all locations in California’s electricity market after the introduction of financial trading. We then present evidence suggesting that operating costs and input fuel use fell after the introduction of financial trading on days when the nonconvexities inherent to the production and transmission of electricity are especially relevant. (JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48)
abstract_zh: 远期市场被认为能够汇总关于未来现货价格的信息，并降低商品的生产成本。我们构建了一个指标，用以衡量在存在交易成本的市场中远期价格与现货价格的吻合程度。利用该指标，我们表明，在引入金融交易之后，加州电力市场各地点的日前价格都更好地反映了实时价格。随后，我们提供证据表明，在电力生产和输送所固有的非凸性尤为突出的日子里，引入金融交易之后运营成本和投入燃料使用量均有所下降。（JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48）

Long-Term Resource Adequacy in Wholesale Electricity Markets with Significant Intermittent Renewables
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy (eds. Kotchen, Deryugina, Stock), University of Chicago Press
abstract: Growing amounts of intermittent renewable generation capacity substantially increases the complexity of determining whether sufficient energy will be available to meet hourly demands throughout the year. As the events of August 2020 in California and February 2021 in Texas demonstrate, supply shortfalls can have large economic and public health consequences. An empirical analysis of these two events demonstrates that similar supply shortfalls are likely to occur in the future without a paradigm shift in how long-term resource adequacy is determined for an electricity supply industry with significant intermittent renewables. An alternative approach to determining long-term resource adequacy that explicitly recognizes the characteristics of different generation technologies is outlined and its properties explored relative to current approaches.
abstract_zh: 间歇性可再生能源发电容量的日益增长，大幅增加了判断全年每小时需求能否得到充足能源供应的复杂性。2020年8月的加州事件和2021年2月的得克萨斯事件表明，供应短缺可能造成巨大的经济和公共卫生后果。对这两起事件的实证分析表明，如果不对拥有大量间歇性可再生能源的电力供应行业中长期资源充裕性的确定方式进行范式转变，类似的供应短缺在未来很可能再次发生。本文提出了一种确定长期资源充裕性的替代方法，该方法明确承认不同发电技术的特征，并探讨了其相对于现行方法的性质。

Designing Nonlinear Price Schedules for Urban Water Utilities to Balance Revenue and Conservation Goals
abstract: This paper formulates and estimates a household-level, billing-cycle water demand model under increasing block prices that accounts for the impact of monthly weather variation, the amount of vegetation on the household's property, and customer-level heterogeneity in demand due to household demographics. The model utilizes US Census data on the distribution of household demographics in the utility's service territory to recover the impact of these factors on water demand. An index of the amount of vegetation on the household's property is obtained from NASA satellite data. The household-level demand models are used to compute the distribution of utility-level water demand and revenues for any possible price schedule. Knowledge of the structure of customer-level demand can be used by the utility to design nonlinear pricing plans that achieve competing revenue or water conservation goals, which is crucial for water utilities to manage increasingly uncertain water availability yet still remain financially viable. Knowledge of how these demands differ across customers based on observable household characteristics can allow the utility to reduce the utility-wide revenue or sales risk it faces for any pricing plan. Knowledge of how the structure of demand varies across customers can be used to design personalized (based on observable household demographic characteristics) increasing block price schedules to further reduce the risk the utility faces on a system-wide basis. For the utilities considered, knowledge of the customer-level demographics that predict demand differences across households reduces the uncertainty in the utility's system-wide revenues from 70 to 96 percent. Further reductions in the uncertainty in the utility's system-wide revenues in the, range of 5 to 15 percent, are possible by re-designing the utility's nonlinear price schedules to minimize the revenue risk it faces given the distribution of household-level demand in its service territory.
abstract_zh: 本文构建并估计了一个家庭层面、以账单周期为单位的用水需求模型，该模型适用于递增阶梯水价，并考虑了月度天气变化、家庭房产上的植被数量以及由家庭人口结构所导致的客户层面需求异质性的影响。该模型利用美国人口普查数据中关于公用事业公司服务区域内家庭人口结构分布的信息，来恢复这些因素对用水需求的影响。家庭房产上植被数量的指数取自NASA卫星数据。家庭层面的需求模型被用于计算任意可能价格方案下公用事业层面的用水需求和收入分布。掌握客户层面的需求结构，公用事业公司便可以设计非线性定价方案，以实现相互竞争的收入或节水目标。这对于水务公用事业公司在水资源日益不确定的情况下保持财务可持续性而言至关重要。了解这些需求如何因家庭可观察特征而在客户之间存在差异，可以使公用事业公司在任何定价方案下降低其面临的全公司收入或销量风险。了解需求结构如何在客户之间变化，可以用于设计个性化的（基于可观察的家庭人口特征）递增阶梯水价方案，从而进一步降低公用事业公司在全系统层面面临的风险。就所考察的公用事业公司而言，能够预测家庭间需求差异的客户层面人口统计信息，将其全系统收入的不确定性降低了70%至96%。通过重新设计公用事业公司的非线性价格方案，使其在服务区域内家庭层面需求分布下最小化所面临的收入风险，还可以进一步将全系统收入的不确定性降低5%至15%。

title: Market design in an intermittent renewable future: cost recovery with zero-marginal-cost resources
abstract: The basic features of an efficient short-term wholesale market design do not necessarily need to change to accommodate a significantly larger share of zero-marginal-cost, intermittent renewable energy from wind and solar resources. A large share of controllable zero-marginal-cost generation does not create any additional market design challenge relative to a market with a large share of controllable positive marginal cost generation. Regardless of the technology, generation unit owners must recover their fixed costs from sales of energy, ancillary services, and long-term resource adequacy products.
abstract_zh: 高效的短期批发市场设计的基本特征，未必需要为适应来自风能和太阳能资源的大比例、零边际成本且具有间歇性的可再生能源而改变。大比例的可控零边际成本发电，相对于大比例的可控正边际成本发电，并不会带来任何额外的市场设计挑战。无论技术类型如何，发电机组所有者都必须通过能源销售、辅助服务以及长期资源充裕性产品来回收其固定成本。

title: Retail Pricing in Colombia to Support the Efficient Deployment of Distributed Generation and Electric Stoves
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 110, 102541
abstract: Electricity tariff reforms will be an essential part of the clean energy transition. Existing tariffs rely on average cost pricing and often set a price per unit that exceeds marginal cost. The higher price encourages over-adoption of residential solar panels and under-adoption of electric alternatives to fossil fuels. However, an efficient tariff based on fixed charges and marginal cost pricing may harm low-income households. Households with low demand for electricity may prefer to disconnect from the grid rather than pay an equal share of fixed costs. This paper proposes an alternative methodology for setting fixed charges based on the predicted willingness-to-pay of each household. Household data from Colombia are used to show the fiscal burden and economic inefficiency of the existing tariffs. The paper then shows how the new tariff methodology could improve economic efficiency and create incentives for the adoption of clean energy technologies, while still leaving low-income households better off.
abstract_zh: 电价改革将是清洁能源转型的重要组成部分。现行电价依赖平均成本定价，单位价格往往定在超过边际成本的水平。较高的价格鼓励了居民太阳能电池板的过度采用，同时阻碍了化石燃料替代性电气技术的采用。然而，基于固定费用和边际成本定价的有效电价可能损害低收入家庭的利益。用电需求较低的家庭可能宁愿脱离电网，也不愿分担同等份额的固定成本。本文提出了一种替代方法，根据每个家庭的预测支付意愿来设定固定费用。利用哥伦比亚的家庭数据，本文展示了现行电价的财政负担和经济低效率。随后，本文说明了新的电价方法如何能够提高经济效率，并激励清洁能源技术的采用，同时仍使低收入家庭的境况得到改善。

title: Wholesale Electricity Market Design
venue: Handbook on the Economics of Electricity Markets (eds. Glachant, Joskow, Pollitt), Cambridge University Press (book chapter)
abstract: This paper identifies the key features of successful wholesale electricity market designs. These include: (1) the match between the short-term market used to dispatch generation units and the physical operation oftheelectricity network, (2) effective regulatory and market mechanisms to ensure long-term generation resource adequacy, (3) appropriate mechanisms to mitigate local market power, and (4) mechanisms to allow the active involvement of final demand in the short-term market. This is followed by a discussion of how these lessons can be applied to developing countries and small markets so that these regions can benefit from wholesale electricity competition at lower cost and with less administrative burden than larger markets. Market design enhancements that support thecost-effectiveintegration of both grid-scale and distributed renewablesarebriefly discussed. The paper closes with proposed directions for future researchin the area ofelectricity market design.
abstract_zh: 本文确定了成功的批发电力市场设计的关键特征，包括：（1）用于调度发电机组的短期市场与电网物理运行之间的匹配；（2）确保长期发电资源充裕性的有效监管与市场机制；（3）减轻地方市场势力的适当机制；以及（4）允许最终需求积极参与短期市场的机制。随后，本文讨论了如何将这些经验应用于发展中国家和小型市场，使这些地区能够以较低成本和较少行政负担从批发电力竞争中获益，而无需承担大型市场那样的负担。本文简要讨论了有助于以具有成本效益的方式整合电网规模及分布式可再生能源的市场设计改进。文章最后提出了电力市场设计领域未来研究的方向。

title: Can Incentives to Increase Electricity Use Reduce the Cost of Integrating Renewable Resources?
abstract: We report results from a large field experiment that with a few hours prior notice provided Danish residential consumers with dynamic price and environmental signals aimed at causing them to shift their consumption either into or away from certain hours of the day. The same marginal price signal is found to cause substantially larger consumption shifts into target hours compared to consumption shifts away from target hours. Consumption is also reduced in the hours of the day before and after these into target hours and there is weaker evidence of increased consumption in the hours surrounding away target hours. The same into versus away results hold for the environmental signals, although the absolute size of the eects are smaller. Using detailed household-level demographic information for all customers invited to participate in the experiment, both models are re-estimated accounting for this decision. For both the price and environmental treatments, the same qualitative results are obtained, but with uniformly smaller quantitative magnitudes. These selection-corrected estimates are used to perform a counterfactual experiment where all of the retailer’s residential customers are assumed to face these dynamic price signals. We find substantial wholesale energy cost savings for the retailer from declaring into events designed to shift consumption from high demand periods to low demand periods within the day, which suggests that such a pricing strategy could significantly reduce the cost of increasing the share of greenhouse gas free wind and solar electricity production in an electricity supply industry.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项大规模现场实验的结果。该实验提前数小时通知丹麦居民用户，向其提供动态价格和环境信号，旨在促使其将用电量转入或转出一天中的某些时段。相同的边际价格信号所引起的转入目标时段的用电量变化，显著大于转出目标时段的用电量变化。目标时段前后相邻时段的用电量也有所减少，并且有较弱的证据表明，在围绕转出目标时段的时段内用电量有所增加。环境信号也呈现同样的转入与转出差异，尽管其效应的绝对规模较小。利用所有受邀参与实验的客户的详细家庭人口统计信息，我们重新估计了两个模型，以考虑参与决策这一环节。对于价格和环境两种处理，均得到了相同的定性结果，但定量幅度一致较小。这些经过选择修正的估计值被用于一项反事实实验，假设零售商的所有居民客户都面临这些动态价格信号。我们发现，对零售商而言，发布旨在将用电量从高需求时段转移到低需求时段的事件，能够带来可观的批发能源成本节约。这表明，此类定价策略可以显著降低在电力供应行业中提高温室气体零排放风能和太阳能发电比例的成本。

abstract: Solar lanterns are promoted across rural Sub-Saharan Africa as a way to improve educational outcomes. A randomized controlled trial in Zimba District, Zambia, evaluates whether solar lanterns help children study and improve academic performance. The research design accounts for potential income effects from receiving a lantern and also “blinds” participants to the study's purpose. There is no relationship detected between receipt of a solar lantern and improved performance on key examinations. Impacts on self-reported study habits are also not observed. A cost-effectiveness analysis suggests that solar lanterns are not an efficient way to improve educational outcomes in developing countries relative to other available options. Two phenomena, both of which are likely observed in other developing regions, may explain these results. First, flashlights have become the dominant lighting source in rural Zambia, so solar lanterns may have only limited appeal for prospective users who no longer rely on traditional lighting options like kerosene lamps. Second, improved energy access – whether through solar lanterns or other technologies – appears to be a relatively unimportant educational input in settings like Zimba.
abstract_zh: 太阳能灯笼在撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区被广泛推广，以改善教育成果。在赞比亚辛巴区（Zimba District）开展的一项随机对照试验，评估了太阳能灯笼是否能帮助儿童学习并提高学业成绩。研究设计考虑了获得灯笼可能带来的收入效应，并对参与者隐瞒了研究目的（即“盲化”处理）。研究未发现获得太阳能灯笼与关键考试成绩提高之间存在任何关系。对自我报告的学习习惯的影响也未被观察到。成本效益分析表明，相对于其他现有选项，太阳能灯笼并不是改善发展中国家教育成果的有效途径。有两种现象可能解释这些结果，且这两种现象在其他发展中地区也很可能存在。第一，手电筒已成为赞比亚农村地区的主要照明来源，因此，太阳能灯笼对那些已不再依赖煤油灯等传统照明方式的潜在用户而言，吸引力可能十分有限。第二，无论是通过太阳能灯笼还是其他技术改善能源可及性，在辛巴这类地区似乎都是相对不重要的教育投入。

title: Increasing the energy cognizance of electricity consumers in Mexico: Results from a field experiment
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 102323
abstract: We report on the results of a field experiment in Puebla, Mexico that informed randomly-selected households facing a nonlinear price schedule about how different electricity-consuming actions might change their electricity bills. Households that received this 20-minute, in-person intervention reduced their electricity use, with much of this reduction driven by those that paid the highest marginal price for electricity. The estimated impacts were durable with no observed rebound for at least a year. Households with less educational attainment reduced use the most, consistent with the conclusion that the intervention imparted new knowledge to consumers that led to this observed behavior change. The high rate at which customers accepted the intervention, the resulting consumption decrease, and low implementation costs make this intervention cost-effective relative to several previous energy conservation campaigns in Mexico.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了在墨西哥普埃布拉（Puebla）开展的一项现场实验结果。该实验向面临非线性电价表的随机抽选家庭告知，不同的用电行为可能如何改变其电费账单。接受这项20分钟、面对面干预的家庭减少了用电量，其中很大一部分降幅来自那些支付最高边际电价的家庭。估计的影响具有持久性，至少一年内未观察到反弹。受教育程度较低的家庭减少用电量最多，这与干预向消费者传授了新知识、从而引发上述行为改变的结论相一致。客户对干预的高接受率、由此带来的用电量下降以及较低的实施成本，使该干预相较墨西哥此前的若干项节能运动具有成本效益。

title: An Experimental Comparison of Carbon Pricing Under Uncertainty in Electricity Markets
abstract: We report on an economic experiment that compares outcomes in electricity markets subject to carbon-tax and cap-and-trade policies. Under conditions of uncertainty, price-based and quantitybased policy instruments cannot be truly equivalent, so we compared three matched carbon-tax/ cap-and-trade pairs with equivalent emissions targets, mean emissions, and mean carbon prices, respectively. Across these matched pairs, the cap-and-trade mechanism produced much higher wholesale electricity prices (38.5% to 52.6% higher) and lower total electricity production (2.5% to 4.0% lower) than the "equivalent" carbon tax, without any lower carbon emissions. Market participants who forecast a lower price of carbon in the cap-and-trade games ran their units more than those who forecast a higher price of carbon, which caused emissions from the dirtiest generating units (Coal and Gas Peakers) to be significantly higher (15.2% to 33.0%) than in the carbon tax games. These merit order "mistakes" in the cap-and-trade games suggest an important advantage of the carbon tax as policy: namely, that the cost of carbon can treated by firms as a known input to production.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项经济学实验，比较了分别实施碳税和总量控制与交易政策的电力市场结果。在不确定性条件下，基于价格的政策工具与基于数量的政策工具不可能真正等价，因此我们分别比较了三组匹配的碳税/总量控制与交易配对，它们分别具有等同的排放目标、平均排放量和平均碳价格。在这些匹配配对中，总量控制与交易机制带来的批发电价显著更高（高出38.5%至52.6%），电力总产量更低（低2.5%至4.0%），但并未带来更低的碳排放，而所谓“等价”的碳税机制则没有这些问题。在总量控制与交易博弈中，预测碳价格较低的市场参与者比预测碳价格较高的参与者更多地运行其机组，这导致最脏的发电机组（煤电和燃气调峰机组）的排放量显著高于碳税博弈中的排放量（高出15.2%至33.0%）。总量控制与交易博弈中这些按边际成本次序（merit order）出现的“错误”表明，碳税作为政策工具具有一项重要优势，即企业可以将碳成本视为生产中已知的投入要素。

abstract: We study potential equilibria in California’s cap-and-trade market for greenhouse gases (GHGs) based on information available before the market started. We find large ex ante uncertainty in business-as-usual emissions and in the abatement that might result from non-market policies, much larger than the reduction that could plausibly occur in response to an allowance price within a politically acceptable range. This implies that the market price is very likely to be determined by an administrative price floor or ceiling. Similar factors seem likely to be present in other cap-and-trade markets for GHGs. title: The Benefits of Purely Financial Participants for Wholesale and Retail Market Performance: Lessons for Long-Term Resource Adequacy Mechanism Design
The Role of Efficient Pricing in Enabling a Low-Carbon Electricity Sector
abstract: Producers and consumers will make the investments and innovations necessary to transition to a low carbon electricity supply industry only if they are compensated for their efforts. In the absence of explicit government support for these activities, this outcome will occur only if wholesale and retail prices provide this compensation. Efficient wholesale and retail pricing provides compensation for the cost-effective deployment of these innovations. Multi-settlement locational marginal pricing markets set efficient short-term wholesale electricity prices. Marginal cost-based pricing of transmission and distribution networks is increasingly important in regions with solar resources. More efficient wholesale and retail pricing implies significantly greater price volatility, particularly as the share of intermittent renewable generation increases, which requires implementing a number of competition and regulatory safeguards to protect consumers, while still providing the price signals necessary for a least cost transition to a low-carbon electricity supply industry.
abstract_zh: 只有当生产者和消费者的投资与创新努力获得补偿时，他们才会进行向低碳电力供应行业转型所必需的投资和创新。在政府没有为这些活动提供明确支持的情况下，只有批发和零售价格能够提供这种补偿，上述结果才会出现。高效的批发与零售定价能够为具有成本效益的创新部署提供补偿。多结算的节点边际电价（locational marginal pricing）市场能够设定高效的短期批发电价。在太阳能资源丰富的地区，输配电网络基于边际成本的定价正变得日益重要。更高效的批发与零售定价意味着价格波动显著加大，特别是随着间歇性可再生能源发电占比的提高，这需要实施一系列竞争与监管保障措施以保护消费者，同时仍须提供必要的价格信号，以实现向低碳电力供应行业的最低成本转型。

abstract: Hourly plant-level wind and solar generation output and real-time price data for one year from the California ISO control area is used to estimate the vector of means and the contemporaneous covariance matrix of hourly output and revenues across all wind and solar locations in the state. Annual hourly output and annual hourly revenues mean/standard deviation efficient frontiers for wind and solar resource locations are computed from this information. For both efficient frontiers, economically meaningful differences between portfolios on the efficient frontier and the actual wind and solar generation capacity mix are found. The relative difference is significantly larger for aggregate hourly output relative to aggregate hourly revenues, consistent with expected profit-maximizing unilateral entry decisions by renewable resource owners. Most of the hourly output and hourly revenue risk-reducing benefits from the optimal choice of locational generation capacities is captured by a small number of wind resource locations, with the addition of a small number of solar resource locations only slightly increasing the set of feasible portfolio mean and standard deviation combinations. Measures of non-diversifiable wind and solar energy and revenue risk are computed using the actual market portfolio and the risk-adjusted expected hourly output or hourly revenue maximizing portfolios.

venue: Manufacturing Markets: Legal, Political and Economic Dynamics (eds. Glachant and Brousseau), Cambridge University Press (book chapter)
abstract: This paper uses the framework in Wolak (2003a,b and 2007) and data on half-hourly offer curves and market-clearing prices and quantities from the New Zealand wholesale electricity market over the period January 1, 2001 to June 30, 2007 to characterize how the four large suppliers in this imperfectly competitive industry exercise market power. To accomplish this we introduce half-hourly measures of the firm-level ability and incentive of an individual supplier to exercise unilateral market power that are derived from a simplified model of expected profit-maximizing offer behaviour in a multi-unit auction market. We then show that half-hourly market-clearing prices are highly correlated with the half-hourly values of the firm-level and firm-average measures of both the ability and incentive of the four large suppliers in New Zealand to exercise market power. We then present evidence consistent with the view that this increasing relationship between the ability or incentive of individual suppliers to exercise market power and higher market-clearing prices is caused by the four large suppliers submitting higher offer prices when they have a greater ability or incentive to exercise unilateral market power. We show that after controlling for changes in input fossil fuel prices and other factors that impact the opportunity cost of producing electricity during that half hour, each of the four suppliers submits a higher offer price into the wholesale market when it has a greater ability or incentive to exercise unilateral market power. To strengthen the case that this increasing relationship between market prices and the ability and incentive of each of the suppliers to exercise unilateral market power is actually caused by the four large suppliers exercising unilateral market power by changing their offer prices in response to their ability and incentive to exercise market power, we also perform a test of the implications of the null hypothesis that the four large suppliers behave as if they had no ability to exercise market power. We find strong evidence against this null hypothesis and instead find that these hypothesis testing results are consistent with the perspective that these suppliers are exercising all available unilateral market power. abstract_zh: 本文采用Wolak（2003a, b；2007）的分析框架，并利用新西兰批发电力市场2001年1月1日至2007年6月30日期间的半小时报价曲线以及市场出清价格和数量数据，刻画这一不完全竞争行业中四大供应商如何行使市场势力。为此，我们引入了半小时层面的指标，用以衡量单个供应商单边行使市场势力的能力和激励，这些指标由多单元拍卖市场中预期利润最大化报价行为的简化模型推导而来。随后我们表明，半小时市场出清价格与新西兰四大供应商在企业层面及企业平均层面的行使市场势力能力和激励指标之半小时取值高度相关。我们还提供了证据，支持如下观点：个体供应商行使市场势力的能力或激励与较高市场出清价格之间的这种正向关系，源于四大供应商在自身拥有更大能力或激励行使单边市场势力时提交了更高的报价。在控制化石燃料投入价格变化以及影响该半小时发电机会成本的其他因素之后，我们发现，当每家供应商拥有更大的单边市场势力能力或激励时，它都会向批发市场提交更高的报价。为了进一步论证市场价格与各供应商行使单边市场势力能力和激励之间的这种正向关系，确实是由四大供应商通过根据其能力和激励调整报价来行使单边市场势力所引起的，我们还检验了如下原假设的含义：四大供应商的行为如同其并不具备行使市场势力的能力。我们发现有力证据拒绝该原假设，并发现这些假设检验结果与如下观点相一致：这些供应商正在行使其所有可用的单边市场势力。分类号-JEL：

title: Regulating Competition in Wholesale Electricity Supply
venue: Economic Regulation and Its Reform: What Have We Learned? (ed. Nancy L. Rose), University of Chicago Press (book chapter)
abstract: The experience of the past ten years suggests that the potential benefits from electricity industry restructuring are small relative to those that can be achieved from introducing competition into other network industries such as telecommunications and airlines. In addition, the probability of a costly market failure in the electricity supply industry, often due to the exercise of unilateral market power, appears to be significantly higher than in other network industries. A major theme of this chapter is that electricity industry re-structuring is an evolving process that requires market designers to choose between an imperfectly competitive market and an imperfect regulatory process to provide incentives for least-cost supply at various of stages of the production process. The fundamental goal of the market design process in the wholesale market regime is to limit the ability of suppliers to exercise unilateral market power either explicitly through market price-setting mechanisms or implicitly through the regulatory price-setting process. There are a number ways the regulator can limit the ability of suppliers to exercise unilateral market power–namely, (1) alter the market structure, (2) change market rules, (3) impose penalties and sanctions on market participants for their behavior, and (4) even explicitly set the prices that market participants receive for their production. This chapter provides a theoretical framework for understanding how to make these choices in order to design a wholesale market that benefits consumers relative to the former vertically-integrated utility regime. The paper uses this framework to understand the causes of the disappointing experience with wholesale electricity restructuring in the US. This discussion points to a number of ways to increase the likelihood that restructuring in the US will ultimately benefit consumers. 1.
abstract_zh: 过去十年的经验表明，与在电信和航空等其他网络产业中引入竞争所能获得的收益相比，电力行业重组带来的潜在收益很小。此外，电力供应行业发生代价高昂的市场失灵的概率（通常由单边市场势力的行使所致）似乎明显高于其他网络产业。本章的一个主要主题是，电力行业重组是一个不断演进的过程，市场设计者需要在不完全竞争的市场与不完善的监管过程之间进行选择，以便在生产过程的各个阶段为最低成本供应提供激励。批发市场机制中市场设计过程的根本目标，是限制供应商通过市场定价机制显性行使或通过监管定价过程隐性行使单边市场势力的能力。监管者可以通过多种方式限制供应商行使单边市场势力，即：（1）改变市场结构，（2）改变市场规则，（3）对市场参与者的行为施加处罚和制裁，以及（4）甚至直接设定市场参与者的生产价格。本章提供了一个理论框架，用以理解如何做出这些选择，从而设计一个相较于此前纵向一体化公用事业体制能够使消费者受益的批发市场。本文运用该框架来理解美国批发电力重组令人失望的经验的成因。该讨论指出了若干途径，可提高美国重组最终使消费者受益的可能性。1.

title: Carbon in the Classroom: Lessons from a Simulation of California's Electricity Market Under a Stringent Cap-and-Trade System
Economic and Political Constraints on the Demand-Side of Electricity Industry Re-structuring Processes
venue: Review of Economics and Institutions, 4(1), Article 1
abstract: This paper identifies the major political and economic constraints that impact the demand-side of electricity industry re-structuring processes. These constraints have been a major barrier to implementing effective restructuring processes in many countries, particularly those in the developing world. The paper describes how these constraints have been addressed and how this has harmed market efficiency and system reliability using examples from re-structuring processes around the world. The paper proposes demand-side regulatory interventions to manage these constraints in a manner that limits the harm to wholesale market efficiency. Finally, specific regulatory inventions for developing countries are proposed.
abstract_zh: 本文识别了影响电力行业重组过程需求侧的主要政治和经济约束。这些约束已成为许多国家（尤其是发展中国家）实施有效重组进程的主要障碍。本文以世界各地重组进程为例，描述了这些约束是如何被处理的，以及这种处理如何损害了市场效率和系统可靠性。本文提出了需求侧监管干预措施，以管理这些约束，同时限制其对批发市场效率的损害。最后，本文为发展中国家提出了具体的监管创新建议。

abstract: This paper identifies the major political and economic constraints that impact the demand side of electricity industry restructuring processes. Demand-side constraints have been a major barrier to implementing effective restructuring processes in many countries, particularly those in developing world. I describe how these constraints have been addressed and how this has harmed market efficiency and system reliability using examples from restructuring processes throughout world. I propose demand-side regulatory interventions to manage these constraints in a manner that limits the harm to wholesale market efficiency. Finally, specific regulatory inventions for developing countries such as India are proposed.
abstract_zh: 本文识别了影响电力行业重组进程需求侧的主要政治和经济约束。需求侧约束已成为许多国家（尤其是发展中国家）实施有效重组进程的主要障碍。本人以全球各地重组进程为例，描述了这些约束是如何被处理的，以及这种处理如何损害了市场效率和系统可靠性。本人提出了需求侧监管干预措施，以管理这些约束，同时限制其对批发市场效率的损害。最后，本文为印度等发展中国家提出了具体的监管创新建议。

abstract: Hourly generation unit-level output levels, detailed information on the technological characteristics of generation units, and daily delivered natural gas prices to all generation units for the California wholesale electricity market before and after the implementation of locational marginal pricing are used to measure the impact of introducing greater spatial granularity in short-term energy pricing. The average hourly number of generation unit starts increases, but both the total hourly energy consumed and total hourly operating costs for all natural gas-fired generation units fall by more than 2 percent after the implementation of locational marginal pricing.

title: Reforming the Indian Electricity Supply Industry

abstract: This paper assesses the costs and benefits of further re-structuring of the Indian electricity supply industry. The poor financial condition of the State Electricity Boards (SEBs) has led to a significant decline in private sector participation in new generation investment projects. Agricultural tariffs set far below average cost and massive rates of technical and commercial transmission and distribution losses have necessitated subsidies to electricity consumption that are close to 1 percent the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of India. Under these conditions, further electricity industry re-structuring seems unlikely to benefit the Indian economy and may even make matters worse. Improving the financial health of the SEBs should therefore be a top priority. Introducing wholesale electricity competition without financially solvent SEBs is unlikely to benefit and very likely harm the Indian economy. This paper argues that an effective and credible industry-wide regulatory process is necessary for financial solvency of the SEBs. The paper outlines the key components of this regulatory process and describes how it might be implemented. It closes with recommendations for further re-structuring of the Indian electricity market once the SEBs are financially solvent. These recommendations emphasize that the re-structuring process should be tailored to initial conditions in India in order to capture the greatest possible benefits from wholesale competition with the least risk to the health of the Indian economy.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了进一步重组印度电力供应行业的成本与收益。邦电力局（State Electricity Boards, SEBs）财务状况不佳，导致私营部门在新建发电投资项目中的参与显著下降。农业电价远低于平均成本，且输配电技术损耗与商业损耗比率极高，使得电力消费补贴高达接近印度国内生产总值（GDP）的1%。在这些条件下，进一步的电力行业重组似乎不太可能使印度经济受益，甚至可能使情况更糟。因此，改善邦电力局的财务状况应当成为首要任务。在邦电力局财务尚不具备清偿能力的情况下引入批发电力竞争，不太可能带来收益，而极有可能损害印度经济。本文认为，有效且可信的全行业监管过程是邦电力局实现财务偿付能力的必要条件。本文概述了该监管过程的关键组成部分，并描述了其可能的实施方式。文章最后就邦电力局恢复偿付能力后进一步重组印度电力市场提出了建议。这些建议强调，重组进程应当根据印度的初始条件加以量身定制，以便在将对印度经济健康的风险降至最低的同时，尽可能获取批发竞争带来的收益。

title: Using Environmental Emissions Permit Prices to Raise Electricity Prices: Evidence from the California Electricity Market
abstract: This paper analyzes the extent to which the conditions in the emissions permit market for oxides of nitrogen (NOx) operated by the South Coast Air Quality Management District (SCAQMD) in the Los Angeles metropolitan area interacted with competitive conditions in the California electricity market to enhance the ability of electricity suppliers with some or all of their generation units located in SCAQMD to exercise unilateral market power. We present evidence consistent with the view that NOx emissions permits were a convenient vehicle for enhancing the ability of suppliers to exercise unilateral market power in the California electricity market. We find that generation unit owners with some of their plants located in the SCAQMD paid statistically significantly higher prices for 2000 and 2001 NOx emissions permits than other participants in the SCAQMD emissions market, despite the fact the prices they paid for 1998 and 1999 vintage permits were no different from other SCAQMD participants. We then present evidence consistent with the view that wholesale electricity suppliers did not operate and bid their generation units requiring NOx emissions permits in a manner consistent with higher emission permit prices being a cause of increased production costs. Taken together, this evidence suggests that NOx emission permit prices during 2000 and 2001 were primarily used by these generation unit owners to cost-justify higher bids into the California electricity market that would set higher prices for all electricity they produced.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了洛杉矶大都市区南海岸空气质量管理区（South Coast Air Quality Management District, SCAQMD）运营的氮氧化物（NOx）排放许可市场的条件，在多大程度上与加利福尼亚电力市场的竞争条件相互作用，从而增强了部分或全部发电机组位于SCAQMD区域内的电力供应商行使单边市场势力的能力。我们提供的证据与如下观点相一致：氮氧化物排放许可是增强供应商在加利福尼亚电力市场中行使单边市场势力能力的便利工具。我们发现，部分电厂位于SCAQMD区域内的发电机组所有者，为2000年和2001年的氮氧化物排放许可支付的价格在统计上显著高于SCAQMD排放市场中的其他参与者，尽管他们为1998年和1999年年份的许可支付的价格与其他SCAQMD参与者并无差异。随后，我们提供的证据与如下观点相一致：批发电力供应商在运营和报价需要氮氧化物排放许可的发电机组时，并未采取与较高排放许可价格导致生产成本上升相一致的方式。综合来看，这些证据表明，2000年和2001年的氮氧化物排放许可价格主要被这些发电机组所有者用来为其向加利福尼亚电力市场提交的较高报价提供成本依据，而这些报价会抬高其所生产全部电力的价格。

abstract: This paper provides a prospective and retrospective quantitative assessment of the impact of a passive vertical integration between a large electricity retailer and a large electricity generator in the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM). We adapt a standard model of fixed-price forward contracting behavior by an electricity retailer before and after the acquisition of a share of a baseload electricity generation plant to determine the likely change in its contracting behavior. Using bid and market outcome data during the three years leading up to the acquisition, we estimate the change in bidding behavior of the generation unit owner from the change in its fixed-price forward contract obligations brought about by the acquisition. This change in bidding behavior is used to compute a prospective change in each half-hourly wholesale price during the pre-acquisition period. Because this acquisition was allowed to take place, we also use market-clearing prices of wholesale electricity in the four states of Australia in NEM at that time and the price of the marginal input fuel during the pre-acquisition and post-acquisition time periods to compute a variety of treatment effects estimates of the impact of this acquisition. We find fairly close agreement between the prospective and retrospective quantitative impact of the acquisition on wholesale prices. In both methodologies find a significant increase in wholesale electricity prices associated with the acquisition, which emphasizes the importance of taking into account the extreme susceptibility of short-term wholesale electricity markets to the exercise of unilateral market in any competition analysis in this industry.
abstract_zh: 本文对澳大利亚国家电力市场（National Electricity Market, NEM）中一家大型电力零售商与一家大型发电商之间的被动纵向整合的影响，进行了前瞻性和回顾性的定量评估。我们借鉴了标准的固定价格远期合约模型，刻画电力零售商在收购基荷发电厂部分股权前后的固定价格远期合约行为，以确定其合约行为可能的变化。利用收购前三年的报价和市场结果数据，我们根据收购导致的该发电机组所有者固定价格远期合约义务的变化，估计了其报价行为的变化。该报价行为变化被用于计算收购前时期每个半小时批发电价的前瞻性变化。由于此次收购获得了批准，我们还利用当时澳大利亚四个州国家电力市场的批发电力市场出清价格，以及收购前后时期的边际投入燃料价格，计算了该收购影响的多种处理效应估计。我们发现前瞻性与回顾性的定量影响结果较为接近。两种方法均表明，该收购与批发电价的显著上涨相关，这强调了在该行业的任何竞争分析中，必须充分考虑短期批发电力市场极易受到单边市场势力行使影响这一特性。

abstract: This paper first describes those features of the electricity supply industry that make a prospective market monitoring process essential to a well-functioning wholesale market. Some of these features are shared with the securities industry, although the technology of electricity production and delivery make a reliable transmission network a necessary condition for an efficient wholesale market. These features of the electricity supply industry also make antitrust or competition law alone an inadequate foundation for an electricity market monitoring process. This paper provides examples of both the successes and failures of market monitoring from several international markets. More than ten years of experience with the electricity industry re-structuring process has demonstrated that market failures are more likely and substantially more harmful to consumers than other market failures because of how electricity is produced and delivered and the crucial role it plays in the modern economy. Wholesale market meltdowns of varying magnitudes and durations have occurred in electricity markets around the world, and many of them could have been prevented if a prospective market monitoring process backed by the prevailing regulatory authority had been in place at the start of the market.
abstract_zh: 本文首先描述了电力供应行业的某些特征，这些特征使得前瞻性的市场监管过程对于一个运行良好的批发市场而言至关重要。其中一些特征与证券行业相同，但电力生产和输送的技术特性使得可靠的输电网络成为高效批发市场的必要条件。电力供应行业的这些特征也使得反垄断或竞争法本身不足以作为电力市场监管过程的基础。本文列举了多个国际市场中市场监管成功与失败的案例。电力行业重组进程十余年的经验表明，由于电力的生产和输送方式以及电力在现代经济中的关键作用，电力市场失灵比其他市场失灵更容易发生，且对消费者的危害也大得多。世界各地的电力市场都曾发生过不同规模和持续时间的批发市场崩溃，而其中许多本可以通过在市场启动之初即建立由现行监管机构支持的前瞻性市场监管过程加以预防。

title: Lessons from the California Electricity Crisis

abstract: This chapter analyzes the possible causes of the electricity crisis in California in 2000. It argues against the belief that the crisis was caused by a combination of rising input costs, poor market design, and the exercise of market power and failed market oversight by state and federal regulators, and suggests that the crisis fundamentally a regulatory crisis rather than an economic crisis. This chapter suggests that the most important lesson from the California crisis relates to how the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) carries out its statutory mandate to set just and reasonable wholesale prices in a market regime.
abstract_zh: 本章分析了2000年加利福尼亚电力危机的可能成因。本章反驳了如下观点：即危机是由投入成本上升、市场设计不佳、市场势力行使，以及州和联邦监管者未能有效监管市场等因素共同造成的。本章认为，该危机在根本上是一场监管危机，而非经济危机。本章指出，加利福尼亚危机最重要的教训，涉及联邦能源监管委员会（Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, FERC）如何履行其法定职责，即在市场机制下设定公正合理的批发价格。

abstract: We present a method for decomposing wholesale electricity payments into production costs, inframarginal competitive rents, and payments resulting from the exercise of market power. Using data from June 1998 to October 2000 in California, we find significant departures from competitive pricing during the high-demand summer months and near-competitive pricing during the lower-demand months of the first two years. In summer 2000, wholesale electricity expenditures were $8.98 billion up from $2.04 billion in summer 1999. We find that 21 percent of this increase was due to production costs, 20 percent to competitive rents, and 59 percent to market power.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种方法，将批发电力支付分解为生产成本、边际内竞争性租金以及因行使市场势力而产生的支付。利用加利福尼亚1998年6月至2000年10月的数据，我们发现，在需求高峰的夏季月份，电价显著偏离竞争性定价，而在前两年需求较低的月份，电价则接近竞争性水平。2000年夏季，批发电力支出为89.8亿美元，高于1999年夏季的20.4亿美元。我们发现，这一增幅的21%源于生产成本，20%源于竞争性租金，59%源于市场势力。

title: An Empirical Analysis of the Impact of Hedge Contracts on Bidding Behavior in a Competitive Electricity Market
abstract: A major concern in the design of wholesale electricity markets is the potential for the exercise of market power by generating unit owners. To better understand the determinants of generating unit owner market power and how it is exercised, this paper derives a model of bidding behavior in a competitive electricity market which incorporates various sources of uncertainty and the impact of the electricity generator's position in the financial hedge contract market on its expected profit-maximizing bidding behavior. The model is first used to characterize the profit-maximizing market price that a generator would like set by its bidding strategy for several hedge contract and spot sales combinations. This model is applied to bid and contract data obtained from the first three months of operation of the National Electricity Market (NEM1) in Australia. This analysis illustrates the sensitivity of expected profit-maximizing bidding strategies to the amount of financial hedge contracts held by the generating unit owner. It also provides strong evidence for the effectiveness of financial hedge contracts as a means to mitigate market power during the initial stages of operation of a wholesale electricity market. title: Can Universal Service Survive in a Competitive Telecommunications Environment? Evidence from the Consumer Expenditure Survey
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to assess the impact of reducing the magnitude of the cross-subsidy in telephone services pricing that flows from long-distance service to local service on the consumption of both of these telephone services and consumer welfare at the household level. Our econometric modeling framework specifies a complete system of household-level demand functions that are derived from the assumption of utility maximization. Our primary data source is the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Survey of Consumer Expenditures. In addition to local and long-distance phone service, food, clothing, and other non-durable expenditures are included in our five-good demand system. All of our price change scenarios point to the conclusion that there appears to be little loss in household-level welfare and little, if any, reduction in the number of households connected to the local telephone network, due to the projected reductions in this cross-subsidy brought about by an increasing amount of competition in all telecommunications markets. In addition, we find that if these local service price increases are coupled with reductions in the price of long-distance service, the net effect can actually be a gain in consumer welfare for a large fraction of households which in the aggregate yields a net benefit to the population of United States households.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在评估降低电信服务定价中交叉补贴幅度（即由长途服务向本地服务的补贴）所产生的影响，包括对这两种电信服务消费量以及家庭层面消费者福利的影响。我们的计量经济学框架设定了一套完整的家庭层面需求函数体系，该体系由效用最大化假设推导得出。我们的主要数据来源是美国劳工统计局的消费者支出调查（Survey of Consumer Expenditures）。除本地和长途电话服务外，食品、服装及其他非耐用品支出也被纳入我们的五商品需求系统。所有价格变动情景均表明，由于所有电信市场竞争加剧所带来的交叉补贴预期削减，家庭层面的福利损失很小，接入本地电话网络的家庭数量也几乎没有减少，即便有所减少，幅度也很小。此外，我们发现，如果本地服务价格上涨的同时长途服务价格下降，那么对于很大一部分家庭而言，净效应实际上可能是消费者福利的增加，并在总体上为美国家庭带来净收益。

abstract: This paper analyzes the potential market power of western states in setting coal severance taxes and the emphasis placed by these states on the development of their coal resources vs. obtaining tax revenues. Three market structures are analyzed. One involves a western regional cartel, setting taxes collectively. The other cases are noncooperative tax equilibria with Montana and Wyoming competing against each other. We conclude that the western states seem to be primarily concerned with revenue collection and are very efficient extractors of economic rent.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了美国西部各州在设定煤炭开采税方面可能拥有的市场势力，以及这些州在发展煤炭资源与获取税收收入之间所侧重的取向。本文分析了三种市场结构。一种是西部地区的区域性卡特尔，集体设定税率。另外几种情形是蒙大拿州与怀俄明州相互竞争的非合作税收均衡。我们的结论是，西部各州似乎主要关注税收征集，并且是非常高效的经济租金攫取者。

title: Competition in Interregional Taxation: The Case of Western Coal
abstract: Markets for many products are dominated by small group of states or countries with a natural advantage in the marketplace because of some initial endowment of resources, favorable climate, or location. The purpose of this paper is to explore how such markets involving a few political jurisdictions interact noncooperatively. We examine how such a market might be structured and operate and the extent of monopoly rent that can be extracted in the absence of collusion. We answer these questions for an empirically estimated model of western U.S. coal in which two states (Montana and Wyoming) dominate production. We demonstrate that in this market the amount of rent that can be extracted is greatly reduced through competition (relative to a cartel). Nevertheless, even with two producing states competing against each other, significant rents can be captured--significant enough to refute the contention that little rent can accrue without a cartel.
abstract_zh: 许多产品的市场由少数几个州或国家主导，这些州或国家因其初始资源禀赋、气候条件或地理位置而在市场中具有天然优势。本文旨在探讨由少数政治辖区参与的此类市场如何进行非合作互动。我们考察了此类市场可能的结构和运行方式，以及在没有串通的情况下可以攫取的垄断租金规模。我们针对美国西部煤炭市场的一个经验估计模型回答了这些问题，在该市场中，蒙大拿州和怀俄明州占据主导性产量。我们证明，在该市场中，通过竞争（相对于卡特尔而言），可攫取的租金大幅减少。尽管如此，即使两个产煤州相互竞争，仍可获取可观的租金，其规模之大足以反驳“若无卡特尔则几乎不能获取租金”的论断。
